blocks.text: The Khalsa celebrates while the Bandais collapse into shame and confusion, and the quarrel immediately spills into a new narrative about Lahora Singh Kalal.
The page closes the divine adjudication but refuses repose, because factional consequences continue outward into personal and political conflict.
Lahora Singh Kalal is the anchor because he carries the transition into the next stage.
